Legacy leaflet map functions

Source: R/leaflet.R
leaflet.map.plot.Rd

Older map functions, kept for existing code. leaflet.map.plot() works only for objects of class STORE.GROUP of an older package (it reads their spec table with columns Latitude and Longitude). leaflet.map.Zoom() zooms a leaflet map to the given points, with a margin of dist degrees, and closes its popups.

Usage

leaflet.map.plot(x, stores = rownames(sg$spec), tiles = F, icon = NULL)

leaflet.map.Zoom(x, lat, long, dist = 0.01)

Arguments

x

A STORE.GROUP object (leaflet.map.plot()) or a leaflet map (leaflet.map.Zoom()).

stores

Names of the stores to show.

tiles

Whether to add the default map tiles.

icon

Optional marker icon (leaflet::makeIcon()); circle markers if NULL.

lat, long

Latitudes and longitudes of the points to zoom to.

dist

Margin around the points, in degrees.

Value

A leaflet map.

Details

For new code, use package leaflet directly: leaflet maps work as dashboard outputs (leafletOutput), and clicks on their markers can be sent to shiny with rvisClickEvents().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
map <- leaflet::addTiles(leaflet::leaflet())
leaflet.map.Zoom(map, lat = c(-33.9, -37.8), long = c(151.2, 144.9), dist = 1)
} # }
